author: bardic-inspiration
name: Mirrorlink Chain Shirt
summary: A chain shirt of polished rings that throws light back at foes.
description: Each ring has been mirror-bright for centuries. Assassins complain they can see their own faces in it.

stats.effect: You have a +1 bonus to AC while wearing this armor. As a Reaction when a creature within 30 feet makes a ranged attack against you with a ray of light or Radiant damage, you can cause the attack to have Disadvantage.
